predictions.articleTitle: Poland vs Sweden Prediction & Match Analysis: Can depleted Poland contain Gyökeres? — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Sweden to avoid defeat via Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes as Group B4's unbeaten leaders exploit Poland's depleted defense.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win reflects Sweden's 44.4% Poisson edge against Kiwior- and Cash-less Poland while covering a 1:1 home-urgency draw (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS Yes align with 2.90 combined lambda, Sweden's 80% BTTS rate, and Poland's makeshift back line (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:1 Scoreline Protection accounts for Poland's two home clean sheets and Sweden's 62.5% big-chance waste rate keeping the score tied (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Sweden's Gyökeres and Isak test Poland's depleted, Kiwior-less back line.

spf.comment: Covers both a 1:2 Sweden win against Poland's depleted defense and a 1:1 draw if home urgency and Swedish wastefulness keep it level, as neither script cleanly eliminates the other.

over_under.comment: Supported by 2.90 combined lambda, 60% Over 2.5 rates for both teams, and Sweden's transition edge against a reshuffled Polish rear guard.

btts.comment: Sweden has scored in all five Group B4 matches (20% clean-sheet rate), while Lewandowski leads a home attack facing a defense that conceded twice Saturday.

score.comment: 1:2 reflects Sweden's transition superiority over Poland's missing defenders, while 1:1 captures the top baseline Poisson cell if Poland holds compact early.

goals.comment: Three goals aligns with the 1:2 Over 2.5 projection and 2.90 lambda total, with two goals representing the 1:1 containment branch.

bqc.comment: Poland drew at half-time in 80% of Group B4 matches before fading (60% Draw-Loss), while Sweden's 70% first-half goal share makes an early away lead the key fork.
